agentsInfo.description: Just handle Initial greetings. Nothing else. Hey, Hi, Hello, Hey there. Good Morning, etc

Answers questions about policies, generic discounts, general information, Frequently Asked Questions, and other knowledge base queries, shipping (which is also called as tat), returns, refund policies, and exchanges, warranty, store addresses, product guides, collaborations, offers, discounts, deals, information about {brand} etc. Always use this for coupon codes, discounts, deals, minimum order value, etc. Do not use this for product related queries like product information, benefits, features, etc.
Just to give fallback message. When no agent is found.

For order status, tracking updates, delivery ETA, tat (turnaround time), and order-related issues. Examples: Where is my order, where is the product ? Track my order, My order is getting delayed, I'm frustrated with the delay of my order. etc. Never use this for returns, refunds, exchanges, etc.

For handoff to human agents. If the query is explicitly about talking human agent. Eg: I want to talk to agent, connect me with human agent, agent chat, chat with agent, chat with support, agent support, connect with us, connect with support, etc. Or if the user is facing an issue in placing an order, payment issues,  issues, etc.

Handles product searches, usages,showing products,checkout,address asking,placing order using natural language. Do not use this for general inquiries. Only use this if user is asking about buying a product, prices, information about the product, how to use a product, benefits, features, related queries. Do not always generate search results. Always respond according to the user query. For example, if user asks 'What is the price of product X?', then answer with the price. If user asks 'What is the product X?', then answer with the product information. Never generate search results for product queries. Do not use this for product related issues like size issues, product not working, product not as described, or complications after using the product.
Handles post-usage product issues like , ineffectiveness, no results, size issues, product not working, product not as described, or complications after using the product.
For order cancellation requests. Not for refunds and returns. I want to cancel my order, i dont want this, cancel my order, ordered by mistake.
When the user got some resolution and says ok, thanks, thank you, bye, etc.
For issues with the order BEFORE usage: damaged products, wrong items shipped, missing items, delayed delivery, etc.

Handles pre-purchase queries including COD availability, collaboration requests, coupon issues, legitimacy concerns, product questions, and return/refund policy. Example phrases: 'Do you offer Cash on Delivery?', 'I want to collaborate with Zop', 'My coupon code is not working', 'Is Zop legit or a scam?', 'Tell me about this product', 'What is your return policy?, 'Scammar, you are scammer, how to return, how to exchange, how to cancel, how to refund, how do I return your product, how do I exchange your product. Also handles Agent chat queries when required in context '

Agent for handle order tracking. If users says where is my order, my order status, track my order, order not delivered, How long will take, order delivery time, waiting for my order, order not received. Also handles Agent chat queries when required in context

Agent for handle cancel queries. Example phrases: 'I want to cancel my order', 'cancel this order', 'I ordered by mistake', 'stop this order', 'please cancel it', 'wrong item ordered', 'can you cancel before shipping'. Why cancelled, when cancelled, how to cancel , cancel kya,. Also handles Agent chat queries when required in context

Handles refund status queries and refund-related concerns. Checks refund status and escalates complex cases to customer service team. Example phrases: 'Where is my refund?', 'Refund status check', 'Refund not received', 'When will I get my refund?', 'Check refund processing', 'Refund inquiry'. Not received my money. Also handles Agent chat queries when required in context

Agent for handles order modification requests including address changes, order updates, and delivery location modifications, order item change. Also handles Agent chat queries when required in context

Handles post-delivery queries including return requests, exchange requests, wrong product delivered, damaged items, missing items, product quality issues, product warranty concerns, and other delivery-related problems. Agent for size and fit help about the CUSTOMER'S OWN body, and for custom or made-to-measure size requests. Handles: helping the customer decide which size to buy for themselves, converting their measurements or their usual size in another brand into this brand's size, sharing or explaining the size chart, true-to-size and fit concerns about themselves, what to do if the size they buy does not fit, their size not being available or not listed, and all custom sizing or custom fitting requests. Example queries: 'I need help with my size', 'I'm small, will it fit me?', 'Should I buy medium or large?', 'What size should I buy?', 'How do I find my size?', 'Is your clothing true to size?', 'I'm a size 6, what would that be in your brand?', 'Do you have a size chart I can look at?', 'Can you suggest a size for a 34-inch bust?', 'What if the size I buy doesn't fit?', 'I am unsure about the sizing', 'Are these sizes for adults or kids?', 'How do your sizes compare to other brands?', 'My size is not available', 'My size is not in the size chart', 'I need a size that isn't listed here', 'I don't want a standard size', 'Can I get a custom size?', 'Do you offer custom sizing?', 'Do you make custom sizes?', 'Can you make custom size?', 'Do you do custom sizing?', 'I want to customize my size', 'Can I customize the size?', 'Do you customize the fitting?'. OUT OF SCOPE for this agent, route to ShoppingAgentV2 instead: any question about the measurements, dimensions or physical specification of the PRODUCT itself. This includes length, width, sleeve length, hem length, inseam, the garment's own bust or waist measurement, how long or short the item is, what a given size measures for that product, and any other attribute or specification of the item. These are product-detail questions, not customer-fit questions, even when the words 'size', 'length' or 'measurement' appear. Never route these to SizeAgent: 'Can you help me with the length of this dress?', 'What is the length of this dress?', 'How long is this kurta?', 'Is this dress floor length or midi?', 'What are the measurements of this product?', 'What is the bust measurement of this dress?', 'How wide is the sleeve on this top?', 'Is the size 12 available?'. Routing test: if the question is about the customer's body or their own fit, use SizeAgent. If the question is about the garment's own measurements or availability, use ShoppingAgentV2.
